issuing_body: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
covered_actors: Content creation industry businesses (game, anime, and advertising industries)
AI developers and providers engaged in content creation
implementation_notes: Non-binding practical guidebook issued by METI's Creative Industries Division (Commerce and Service Industry Policy Group) for the game, anime, and advertising industries, reflecting government discussions and technology levels as of June 2024. It synthesizes legal considerations and practical countermeasures across development/training and generation/use stages covering copyright, design, trademark, unfair competition (trade secrets, shared data with limited access, product indications/configurations), portrait rights, publicity rights, and personal information protection. It explicitly states that it operates under Japanese law, does not constitute authoritative legal interpretation or guarantee legality (leaving final legal interpretation to the judiciary), and should be consulted alongside updated materials from METI/MIC (AI Guidelines for Business v1.0), the Agency for Cultural Affairs, the Cabinet Office Intellectual Property Strategy Secretariat, and the Personal Information Protection Commission.
